title: Page 127
transc:
2 pm  Washn July 27 1864
Helen for Palestine In galls Vermont stop
under changed circumstances do you need more
mules Stanhope About Dayton Snyder have been
shipped The rest wilby held till I
hear from you we have been obliged
to stop shipments of Silvers to you
Wiley Buggy Does the star spangled banner


RR McCaine  Washn July 27th 1864
Harsh Plunder Hennitta For Mutton
Please state how many nugget
Spit you have for the
field after leaving on Acton 
Heights a Saint sufficient to
resist a Coup de main Italy
